description: Curated pairwise ranking expectations over REAL ingested events (tests/fixtures, window 2025-07-01..2026-11-01).
label_provenance: Written by the v0.2 implementer from documented economic reasoning; the same reasoning informed the judgmental weights.
metrics_policy: Because labels are not independent of the scoring rules, these pairs are regression/sanity expectations only. No ranking-quality metric (e.g. pairwise accuracy vs. a chronological baseline) is reported from them.

pairs.rationale: A verified 25 bp rate change carries more policy information than a hold.
An economy-wide policy decision outranks a routine annual report filing.
A new CPI release outranks a revision of an earlier payroll month.
A first release outranks a later revision of the same observation.
An earnings 8-K (item 2.02) outranks an 'other events' 8-K (item 8.01) filed the same day.
A rate cut outranks a framework statement that contains no rate decision.
